question: I have a question. Bonney's Devil Fruit is the "Toshi Toshi no Mi", which allows her to change her age freely. Does that mean that she won't die of her natural lifespan?
answer: You would think so, right? However, in chapter 1072, she says "my powers don't work on living things indefinitely." So, at a certain point, the effects will wear off.
name: anir
